title: Benjamin Franklin

core_fact.text: Benjamin Franklin is famous for many things — inventor, Founding Father, founded the first free public libraries, first Postmaster General.

linked_facts.text: Not the author of the Declaration (that's Jefferson) — Franklin only helped revise it. Not part of the official accepted answer, but useful as a deliberate contrast/'not this person' note given Franklin's deck already flags him as 'NOT A PRESIDENT.'
